June positions are retained only where September filings remain awaited. Rajiv Khanna reportedly manages the portfolio, but no separate Rajiv or family stake is aggregated. Public reporting thresholds prevent a complete or live portfolio claim. Percentages are ownership of each company, not portfolio allocation. Rain Industries was also checked against the original NSE XBRL; the other three records are provider crosschecks, which can share an underlying data feed.
